items.raw_excerpt: 过去几年，生成式 AI 在企业中的典型位置，更多仍停留在工具层面，比如写文案、做图片、回答问题、辅助检索和处理客服等。这些能力当然已经改变了不少岗位的工作方式，但整体来看，它们大多还处在业务外围。一方面，过去模型能力还不够稳定；另一方面，企业也缺少一套能够把 AI 纳入主业务链路的工程化方法。

title_i18n.zh: 从写文案到盯数据、算 ROI，流量见顶后，AI Agent 正在杀进核心业务
title_i18n.en: From copywriting to monitoring data and calculating ROI, AI Agents are now penetrating core business operations as traffic growth plateaus.
title_i18n.es: Desde redactar textos hasta supervisar datos y calcular el ROI, tras alcanzar el pico de tráfico, los Agentes de IA están penetrando en el núcleo del negocio.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 过去几年，生成式 AI 在企业中的典型位置，更多仍停留在工具层面，比如写文案、做图片、回答问题、辅助检索和处理客服等。这些能力当然已经改变了不少岗位的工作方式，但整体来看，它们大多还处在业务外围。一方面，过去模型能力还不够稳定；另一方面，企业也缺少一套能够把 AI 纳入主业务链路的工程化方法。
excerpt_i18n.en: In recent years, generative AI in enterprises has largely remained at the tool level, such as copywriting, image creation, answering questions, assisting with searches, and handling customer service. While these capabilities have certainly transformed how many roles operate, overall, they still mostly reside on the periphery of business operations. On one hand, past models lacked sufficient stability; on the other, companies lacked a systematic engineering approach to integrate AI into core business processes.
excerpt_i18n.es: En los últimos años, la IA generativa en las empresas se ha mantenido principalmente a nivel de herramienta, como redactar textos, crear imágenes, responder preguntas, asistir en búsquedas y gestionar servicios al cliente. Estas capacidades ciertamente han transformado la forma de trabajar en muchos puestos, pero en general, aún se encuentran en la periferia de las operaciones. Por un lado, la capacidad de los modelos no era lo suficientemente estable; por otro, las empresas carecían de un método de ingeniería para integrar la IA en la cadena principal de negocio.

items.raw_excerpt: 试想一下，当机器人伸手去拿桌上的杯子，刚把杯子抬起来，又停住了，随后把它放回原位，然后再次伸手去拿。同一个动作，它重复了一遍，像是忘记了自己刚刚已经做过什么。类似的情况在真实环境中并不少见：按钮明明已经按下，却还在反复按，明明抽屉已经关好，却还在继续推。 这些失败并不是因为它“看不清”，而是因为它缺乏一套能够模拟时空演化的“世界模型”。当前的视觉语言行动模型虽然能够理解图像与指令，但在连续任务中仍然只能依赖当前观测做决策，一旦任务变成长步骤流程，例如拿起物体、移动、放置再到关闭装置，就容易出现动作重复和决策中断的问题，其根本原因在于缺乏对时间的理解能力。 这一问题正在成为具身智能发展的关键瓶颈。现有方法大多基于“看到什么就做什么”的即时反应机制，在短任务中表现良好，但在长序列任务中容易出现动作不连贯和决策漂移。如何让模型不仅能感知当前状态，还能记住过去并预判未来，成为新的核心挑战。 在这样的背景下，西湖大学王东林团队提出了论文 《HiF-VLA：Hindsight, Insight and Foresight for Vision-Language-Action Models》。研究中，HiF-VLA 不再简单依赖历史图像或未来画面预测，而是以“运动”作为时间信息的核心表达，使模型能够同时建模过去的变化、当前状态以及未来趋势，从而实现更稳定的连续决策。 这项研究的意义，不仅在于性能上的提升，更在于提出了一种新的范式，即让机器人从“被动反应”走向“边思考边行动”。在具身智能逐步走向真实世界的过程中，这种对时间的理解能力，正在成为决定系统是否真正可用的关键因素。 论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2512.09928 机器人不再「 忘动作」 在长序列任务 LIBERO-Long 上，这项研究主要测试机器人是否能够连续完成多个动作，例如拿取物体、放置

excerpt_i18n.en: Imagine a robot reaching for a cup on a table, lifting it slightly, then pausing, returning it to its original position, and reaching for it again. It repeats the same action as if forgetting what it just did. Similar scenarios are common in real-world environments: repeatedly pressing a button that has already been pressed, or continuing to push a drawer that is already closed. These failures are not due to an inability to "see clearly," but rather a lack of a "world model" capable of simulating the evolution of time and space. While current vision-language-action models can understand images and instructions, they still rely solely on current observations for decision-making in continuous tasks. Once tasks become long-step processes, such as picking up an object, moving it, placing it, and then closing a device, issues like repeated actions and decision interruptions arise, fundamentally due to a lack of temporal understanding. This problem is becoming a critical bottleneck in the development of embodied intelligence. Most existing methods are based on an immediate reaction mechanism of "do what you see," which performs well in short tasks but often leads to incoherent actions and decision drift in long-sequence tasks. How to enable models not only to perceive the current state but also to remember the past and anticipate the future has become a new core challenge. In this context, the team led by Wang Donglin at Westlake University proposed the paper "HiF-VLA: Hindsight, Insight and Foresight for Vision-Language-Action Models."
excerpt_i18n.es: Imagina que un robot extiende su brazo para tomar una taza sobre la mesa, la levanta, se detiene, la devuelve a su lugar y luego vuelve a intentar tomarla. Repite la misma acción como si olvidara lo que acaba de hacer. Situaciones similares son comunes en entornos reales: presionar repetidamente un botón que ya ha sido activado, o seguir empujando un cajón que ya está cerrado. Estos fallos no se deben a que "no vea bien", sino a la falta de un "modelo del mundo" capaz de simular la evolución del espacio-tiempo. Aunque los modelos actuales de visión, lenguaje y acción pueden comprender imágenes e instrucciones, en tareas secuenciales aún dependen únicamente de observaciones inmediatas para tomar decisiones, lo que se vuelve problemático cuando las tareas se alargan.

Many people have experienced this: asking an AI to draw a character results in a first image that looks great, but the second one starts to differ slightly, and by the third, it’s practically a different person. When tasked with creating a set of posters, each individual piece may be fine, but together they lack stylistic consistency. Or, when generating storyboard frames, the character’s appearance fluctuates—sometimes heavier, sometimes slimmer—with facial features failing to match across images. Even a simple change like adjusting clothing color might inadvertently alter the face as well. These may seem like minor issues, but in real-world applications, they can be critical. In fields such as IP design, brand visuals, content production, and even industrial and medical scenarios, the requirement is never just for a single attractive image, but for consistency across an entire set.

Si le encargas un conjunto de carteles, cada uno por separado está bien, pero juntos el estilo no es para nada uniforme. O si le pides que dibuje un storyboard, la apariencia del personaje cambia: a veces más gordo, a veces más delgado, incluso la cara no coincide. En diseño de IP, identidad visual de marca, producción de contenido e incluso en escenarios industriales y médicos, lo que se exige nunca es que una sola imagen sea atractiva, sino que todo un conjunto sea coherente. excerpt_i18n.en: Leifeng Network and Jingxi exclusively learned that Mo Zihao, the head of product research and CEO of China at Plaud AI, has recently left the company. Sources indicate he may venture into AI hardware entrepreneurship. On May 6, 2025, Mo officially joined Plaud as the CEO of China. By then, Plaud had already proven successful in overseas markets, with cumulative sales exceeding one million units and an ARR reaching $250 million. During his tenure, Mo was responsible for the product research of large models across the global market, the establishment of the China market, business and technical teams, as well as commercialization and user growth. Mo holds a Master of Finance from Peking University's Guanghua School of Management and a bachelor's degree from Sun Yat-sen University's School of Management. Prior to joining Plaud, he had multiple entrepreneurial experiences: During university, he founded China's first online public welfare platform, "Mi Gongyi." This project, through the Mi Gongyi app and WeChat mini-program, allowed users to earn "rice" by engaging in daily activities such as waking up early, walking, checking in, and calling their parents. The "rice" could be exchanged for virtual donation supplies, addressing challenges in public welfare project selection, execution, and review through crowdsourcing, thereby guiding more donation resources into the public welfare system. It was a highly regarded public welfare entrepreneurship case at the time. After leaving Mi Gongyi, Mo delved into the internet sector, serving as a partner and CPO at Nuanwa Technology, where he was responsible for designing sales agent products around overall workflows and exploring ways to replace human labor with technology for sales tasks. Later, he joined Baichuan Intelligence, one of the "AI Six Little Dragons," as the head of product and operations in the healthcare direction, deeply involved in large models.

En ese momento, Plaud ya había demostrado éxito en mercados internacionales, con ventas acumuladas superando el millón de unidades y un ARR de 250 millones de dólares. Durante su mandato, Mo Zihao fue responsable de la I+D de modelos de gran escala para todo el mercado global, la formación de equipos de mercado, operaciones y tecnología en China, así como la comercialización y el crecimiento de usuarios. Mo Zihao es máster en Finanzas por la Escuela de Gestión Guanghua de la Universidad de Pekín y se graduó en la Escuela de Gestión de la Universidad Sun Yat-sen.

excerpt_i18n.en: Today, cutting-edge AI technology has quietly integrated into daily life—from simple interactive queries to complex applications like OpenClaw agents, from video generation to AIGC-produced cinematic short films, with technological evolution clearly visible. This has spurred the rise of SE (Super Entrepreneurs) and OPC (One-Person Companies). As a city of open source, extreme AI application, and deep understanding of developers, Shanghai embraces every developer and entrepreneur riding the AI wave with the pioneering spirit of "Moments of Creation, Right Here in Shanghai." The 2026 Global Developers Pioneer Conference will be held from March 27 to 29 in Xuhui, Shanghai. This edition unfolds in the format of "1 opening ceremony, 3+ competitions, 50+ workshops, 100+ interactive experiences, and N carnivals," covering topics across all fields of "AI+"—from frontier explorations in scientific AI to practical applications of OpenClaw, from trends in Agent intelligence to the implementation of "AI+ industries." Whether you are a developer deeply immersed in technology, an entrepreneur chasing dreams, or an ordinary person eager to try "shrimp farming," you can find your own entry point at this grand event. ▎Highlight 1: Millions of Tokens Given Away Free, Shrimp Farming Experts On-Site Installation. Want to personally raise the hottest "AI crayfish"? The conference features a dedicated "Lobster Farm," where companies like SenseTime, China Telecom, Jieyue, Alibaba Cloud Wuying, and Liulian Intelligence offer "one-stop shrimp farming" services—from installation and deployment to model configuration, from IM channel integration to Skills unlocking, with professional engineers guiding you step by step.
excerpt_i18n.es: Hoy, la tecnología de IA de vanguardia se ha infiltrado silenciosamente en la vida cotidiana, desde simples interacciones de preguntas hasta aplicaciones complejas de agentes como OpenClaw, desde la generación de videos hasta la producción de miniseries cinematográficas con AIGC. La evolución tecnológica es evidente, dando lugar al surgimiento de SE (superemprendedores) y OPC (empresas unipersonales). Como ciudad de código abierto y apertura, de aplicación extrema de IA y de mayor comprensión hacia los desarrolladores, Shanghái, con el espíritu pionero de "Momento de creación, justo en Shanghái", acoge a cada desarrollador y emprendedor que abraza la ola de la IA. La Conferencia Mundial de Desarrolladores de Vanguardia 2026 se celebrará en Xuhui, Shanghái, del 27 al 29 de marzo. Este evento contará con 1 ceremonia de apertura, más de 3 competiciones y más de 50 talleres.
